extDescription.message: Ranked, stable Playwright locators for any element on the page — scored the same way Piwi's dashboard scores them.
extDescription.description: The manifest description: shown by the browser and used as the store listing's summary. At most 132 characters, the Chrome Web Store's limit.

pickElementCommand.message: Pick a locator for an element on the page
pickElementCommand.description: Label of the pick keyboard shortcut in the browser's shortcut settings.

common_languageTag.description: Not shown and not translated: the code of this catalog’s language (its _locales directory, with - for _). Sets the pages’ lang attribute.

common_recordingStartFailed.description: Error shown in the popup when starting a recording fails for an unknown reason.

common_screenshotNoTab.message: There is no tab to capture.
common_screenshotNoTab.description: Bug report: why a screenshot could not be taken.

common_screenshotTabHidden.message: The tab is not the one in front.
common_screenshotTabHidden.description: Bug report: why a screenshot could not be taken. The browser only captures the visible tab.

common_noProject.message: There is no project to refresh.
common_noProject.description: Error from the background worker when a panel asks to refresh data without naming a Piwi project.

common_notConnected.message: Piwi Picker is not connected to a Piwi instance.
common_notConnected.description: Error when data from a Piwi instance is needed and none is set up in Options.

common_catalogRefreshFailed.message: The function catalog could not be refreshed.
common_catalogRefreshFailed.description: Error when the list of test functions could not be downloaded again from Piwi.

common_locatorIndexFailed.message: The tested elements could not be downloaded.
common_locatorIndexFailed.description: Error when the data behind “Tested elements” could not be downloaded from Piwi.

common_replayNeedsPage.message: A replay runs on a web page.
common_replayNeedsPage.description: Error when a bug report replay is started somewhere other than a web page.

common_replayNotSteps.message: This file is not a bug report’s steps: $error$
common_replayNotSteps.description: Error when the file chosen for a replay is not a steps file. $error$ is the first problem found in the file, in English, naming a field of the file.

common_replayNoSteps.description: Error when the bug report chosen for a replay has no steps.

common_replayNeedsAccess.message: Piwi Picker needs access to this site to follow the replay from page to page. Open Piwi Picker on this tab and choose Replay a bug report.
common_replayNeedsAccess.description: Error when a replay starts without the site’s permission. “Replay a bug report” is the popup button (popup_replayBug).

common_replayStartFailed.description: Error when a replay fails to start for an unknown reason.

common_workerNoAnswer.message: Piwi Picker’s background worker did not answer: reload Piwi Picker.
common_workerNoAnswer.description: Error when the part of the extension that runs in the background does not answer a request.

common_enterInstanceUrl.message: Enter the address of your Piwi instance first.
common_enterInstanceUrl.description: Options: shown when testing or saving the connection with no address.

common_apiKeyRejected.message: The instance rejected the API key: check it.
common_apiKeyRejected.description: Options: the Piwi instance answered 401 or 403 to the connection test.

common_instanceStatus.message: The instance answered with an error ($status$).
common_instanceStatus.description: Options: the Piwi instance answered the connection test with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_instanceUnreachable.message: Piwi Picker could not reach the instance: check the address, and that it is running.
common_instanceUnreachable.description: Options: the connection test got no answer.

common_projectsFailed.message: The list of projects could not be read ($status$).
common_projectsFailed.description: Options: listing the instance’s projects failed with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_catalogFailed.message: The function catalog could not be downloaded ($status$).
common_catalogFailed.description: Downloading a project’s test functions failed with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_projectKeyRejected.message: The instance rejected the API key for this project.
common_projectKeyRejected.description: Downloading a project’s tested elements was refused (401 or 403).

common_noLocatorIndex.message: This Piwi instance has no locator index for the project: update Piwi, or check the project.
common_noLocatorIndex.description: The Piwi instance does not know the “locator index” request (an older version) or the project. A locator index lists the locators a project’s tests use.

common_locatorIndexStatus.message: The locator index could not be downloaded ($status$).
common_locatorIndexStatus.description: Downloading a project’s locator index failed with an HTTP error. $status$ is the HTTP status code.

common_locatorIndexInvalid.message: The instance answered with something that is not a locator index.
common_locatorIndexInvalid.description: The Piwi instance’s answer could not be read as a locator index.

badge_recording.description: Toolbar badge while actions are recorded. At most 4 characters.

badge_bug.description: Toolbar badge while a bug report is recorded. At most 4 characters.

badge_replay.description: Toolbar badge while a bug report is replayed. At most 4 characters.

popup_settings.description: Popup: tooltip and accessible name of the gear button that opens the settings page.

popup_workerNotice.message: Piwi Picker was rebuilt since it was loaded, and part of it still runs the previous build, so some tools won’t answer. Reloading ends a recording in progress.
popup_workerNotice.description: Popup notice, seen by developers who build the extension themselves.

popup_reload.description: Popup: button of the notice above.

popup_activeProject.description: Popup: label of the menu choosing which Piwi project applies to this tab.

popup_autoMatched.description: Popup, active project menu: the project is chosen from the page address, and one matches.

popup_autoNoMatch.description: Popup, active project menu: the project is chosen from the page address, and none matches.

popup_testedElements.description: Popup tile: shows on the page which elements the project’s tests reach. Short.

popup_testedElementsHint.message: What your tests reach on this page, and what they miss
popup_testedElementsHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Tested elements”. One line.

popup_testedElementsConnect.message: Connect to your Piwi instance to see what your tests reach
popup_testedElementsConnect.description: Popup tile hint, under “Tested elements”, when no Piwi instance is set up. One line.

popup_reportBug.description: Popup tile: records the steps of a bug. Short.

popup_reportBugHint.message: Record the steps, mark what's wrong → a failing test
popup_reportBugHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Report a bug”. One line.

popup_replayBug.description: Popup tile: plays a bug report’s steps on the current site. Short.

popup_replayBugHint.message: Play its steps on this site, with a cursor, and see if the bug shows
popup_replayBugHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Replay a bug report”. One line.

popup_record.description: Popup tile: records clicks and typing into a test. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_recordHint.description: Popup tile hint, under “Record actions”. At most about 22 characters.

popup_pick.description: Popup tile: click an element of the page to get its locators. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_pickHint.description: Popup tile hint. A locator is Playwright’s way to find an element (see the glossary). At most about 22 characters.

popup_hoverInspect.description: Popup tile: shows the locator of the element under the pointer. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_hoverInspectHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_locatorConsole.description: Popup tile: type a locator and see what it finds. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_locatorConsoleHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_multiPick.description: Popup tile: pick a few items of a list to get a locator for all of them. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_multiPickHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_lint.description: Popup tile: outlines the elements of the page that are hard to find from a test. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_lintHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_assertions.description: Popup tile: suggests checks for an element. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_assertionsHint.description: Popup tile hint. expect(…) is code: keep it as is. At most about 22 characters.

popup_session.description: Popup tile: name elements across pages and export them together. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_sessionHint.description: Popup tile hint: name the elements picked, then export them. At most about 22 characters.

popup_agentContext.description: Popup tile: describes an element for an AI coding agent. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_agentContextHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_testFunctions.description: Popup tile: checks which of the project’s test functions work on this page. At most about 16 characters: the tile is half the popup wide.

popup_testFunctionsHint.description: Popup tile hint, in a tile half the popup wide. At most about 22 characters.

popup_running.description: Popup: marks the tile of the tool running on the page, after “·”.

popup_footerKeys.message: Press $first$–$last$ to run a tool, $tested$ for tested elements, $bug$ to report a bug, $replay$ to replay one
popup_footerKeys.description: Popup footer. Each placeholder is a key shown as a key cap; the keys are the same in every language. $bug$ is the key of Report a bug; $first$ is the first digit key; $last$ is the last digit key; $replay$ is the key of Replay a bug report; $tested$ is the key of Tested elements.

popup_pickShortcut.message: $shortcut$ picks an element without the popup
popup_pickShortcut.description: Popup footer: the browser-wide keyboard shortcut, shown as a key cap. $shortcut$ is the shortcut the browser assigned.

popup_noPickShortcut.message: No pick shortcut assigned: set one
popup_noPickShortcut.description: Popup footer link to the browser’s shortcut settings, when no key is assigned.

popup_docs.description: Popup footer link to the documentation, which is in English.

popup_noTab.message: There is no active tab to work on.

popup_cannotRun.message: Piwi Picker can’t run on this page: browsers keep their own pages and extension stores out of reach.
popup_cannotRun.description: Popup error, on a browser page such as the settings or an extension store.

popup_stopRecording.description: Popup tile during a recording. $count$ is the number of steps recorded.

popup_finishBugReport.description: Popup tile during a bug report recording. $count$ is the number of steps recorded.

popup_stepsSoFar.description: Popup tile hint during a recording.

popup_reviewRecording.description: Popup tile once a recording is stopped. $count$ is the number of steps recorded.

popup_reviewBugReport.description: Popup tile once a bug report recording is stopped.

popup_notExported.description: Popup tile hint once a recording is stopped.

popup_takeScreenshot.description: Popup tile during a bug report recording.

popup_screenshotHint_one.message: Adds this tab, as it is now, to the bug report ($count$ event so far)
popup_screenshotHint_one.description: Popup tile hint under “Take a screenshot”, for one event. $count$ is the number of events recorded.

popup_screenshotHint_other.message: Adds this tab, as it is now, to the bug report ($count$ events so far)
popup_screenshotHint_other.description: Popup tile hint under “Take a screenshot”, for several events. $count$ is the number of events recorded.

popup_reviewBugReportHint.message: Copy the failing test or the report, or download it
popup_reviewBugReportHint.description: Popup tile hint once a bug report recording is stopped.

popup_finishFirst.message: Finish or discard the current recording first
popup_finishFirst.description: Popup tile hint under “Report a bug” while another recording exists.

popup_finishBeforeBug.message: Finish or discard the current recording before reporting a bug.
popup_finishBeforeBug.description: Popup error on “Report a bug” while another recording exists.

popup_permissionNeeded.message: Piwi Picker needs access to this site to record from page to page.
popup_permissionNeeded.description: Popup error when the site permission a recording needs was refused.

popup_cannotRecord.message: Piwi Picker can’t record on this page.
popup_cannotRecord.description: Popup error on a page that is not a web site.

popup_cannotReplay.message: Piwi Picker can’t replay a report on this page.
popup_cannotReplay.description: Popup error on a page that is not a web site.

popup_notRecordedTab.message: This tab is not the one being recorded.
popup_notRecordedTab.description: Popup error on “Take a screenshot” in another tab.

popup_stateUnreadable.message: Piwi Picker couldn’t tell whether a recording is running: open it again.
popup_stateUnreadable.description: Popup error when the recording state could not be read. “it” is the popup.

options_title.description: Settings page: its title and heading.

options_language.description: Settings page: label of the language menu.

options_languageBrowser.description: Settings page, language menu: follow the browser’s language. $language$ is the name of the language shown, in that language.

options_languageHint.message: The language of Piwi Picker’s own texts. Page texts, locators and the tests it writes stay as they are.
options_languageHint.description: Settings page: hint under the language menu.

options_languageSaved.description: Settings page: confirmation after choosing a language.

options_languageFailed.message: The language could not be changed: $error$
options_languageFailed.description: Settings page: error after choosing a language. $error$ is the reason, often in English.

options_connectHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the connection settings.

options_lead.message: Optional. Connected to your Piwi instance, the recorder uses your projects’ own page objects and helper functions, and ranks them live as you record. Picking locators and recording a plain test always work without it.
options_lead.description: Settings page: introduction of the connection settings.

options_instanceUrl.description: Settings page: label of the address field.

options_instanceUrlPlaceholder.description: Settings page: example in the empty address field.

options_apiKey.description: Settings page: label of the API key field.

options_apiKeyHint.message: Create one in the Piwi dashboard, in your account’s API key settings.
options_apiKeyHint.description: Settings page: hint under the API key field.

options_mappingsHeading.description: Settings page: heading of the table saying which Piwi project applies on which site.

options_mappingsHint.message: Which project applies on which site: one instance can serve more than one. Lines are read in order, and the first pattern that matches wins. $star$ matches within one part of the path, $globstar$ across parts, as in a test function’s own address pattern. The branch, optional, is the one deployed at those addresses (a staging site on $example$, say): Tested elements then shows what that branch’s tests reach.
options_mappingsHint.description: Settings page: hint of the project mappings. The placeholders are shown as code. $example$ is a branch name; $globstar$ is the wildcard across parts of a path; $star$ is the wildcard for one part of a path.

options_addMapping.description: Settings page: button adding a line to the project mappings.

options_noMappings.message: No lines yet: add one below.
options_noMappings.description: Settings page: the project mappings are empty.

options_pattern.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s address pattern field.

options_patternPlaceholder.description: Settings page: example in an empty address pattern field. Keep /** at the end.

options_project.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s project menu.

options_projectTestFirst.description: Settings page: project menu before the projects are known.

options_projectChoose.description: Settings page: project menu with nothing chosen.

options_branch.description: Settings page: accessible name of a line’s branch field.

options_branchPlaceholder.description: Settings page: shown in an empty branch field.

options_branchTitle.message: The branch deployed at these addresses: Tested elements shows what its tests reach
options_branchTitle.description: Settings page: tooltip of a line’s branch field.

options_removeMapping.description: Settings page: accessible name of the × button of a line.

options_save.description: Settings page: button saving the connection.

options_privacy.message: Only used from this page: an API key entered here never reaches a web page’s scripts. Recorded steps go nowhere unless you copy or download them. Connecting only downloads each mapped project’s function catalog and the elements its tests reach.
options_privacy.description: Settings page: privacy note at the bottom.

options_testing.description: Settings page: status while testing the connection.

options_accessDenied.message: Access to that instance was refused: allow it to let Piwi Picker read your catalog.
options_accessDenied.description: Settings page: the browser’s permission for the instance address was refused.

options_connected_one.description: Settings page: connection test succeeded, one project. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_connected_other.description: Settings page: connection test succeeded, several projects. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_projectsUnlisted.message: Connected, but the projects could not be listed.
options_projectsUnlisted.description: Settings page: connection test succeeded, listing projects failed.

options_saved_one.description: Settings page: after Save, one project mapping line saved. Other sentences may follow. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_saved_other.description: Settings page: after Save, several project mapping lines saved. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_skipped_one.description: Settings page: after Save, one line lacked a pattern or a project. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_skipped_other.description: Settings page: after Save, several lines lacked a pattern or a project. $count$ is the number of lines.

options_plainHttp.message: This instance uses plain HTTP, so the API key travels unencrypted.
options_plainHttp.description: Settings page: after Save, a warning.

options_refreshDenied.message: Access to the instance was refused, so the catalog will not refresh on its own.
options_refreshDenied.description: Settings page: after Save, the instance permission was refused.

options_cached.description: Settings page: after Save, the test functions downloaded. $functions$ is a count of functions (options_functionCount); $projects$ is a count of projects (options_projectCount).

options_functionCount_one.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of functions.

options_functionCount_other.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of functions.

options_projectCount_one.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_projectCount_other.description: Settings page: part of options_cached. $count$ is the number of projects.

options_catalogsFailed_one.description: Settings page: after Save, downloads that failed. $count$ is the number of catalogs.

options_catalogsFailed_other.description: Settings page: after Save, downloads that failed. $count$ is the number of catalogs.
